body: Twin match is (session, tool_name) within 1.5 s either way, one-to-one; no later cancel of a shown hook prompt when a channel twin arrives past the window (rejected: parallel tool calls of the same tool would close the wrong prompt).

Hook prompts reuse the TASK-014 prompt book with Prompt.hook=true and a new State::Expired; the oneshot lives in Slots.hook_waiters and is settled by reconciliation in pump (Decided -> Some, anything else -> dropped). Alternative (sender inside Prompt) rejected: Prompt is Clone/PartialEq.

serve_hooks keeps its signature (404 on /v1/permission); new serve_hooks_and_permissions + Slots::permission_asks() used by hub::run, so the 15 existing call sites stay untouched. Waiting requests drop their general hook permit and take one of 16 own permits.

Verdict PASS rather than NEEDS_WORK: the unverified blocking-dialog premise is rated a major risk for live QA, not a code defect, because every path stays safe (no decision without an allowlisted press on that prompt). Alternative rejected: block on it before any live evidence exists.
